verdict: populations are effectively indistinguishable (AUC 0.5438): within the matched split the reference and target cannot be told apart, so novelty there is not a proxy for domain shift. The novelty-vs-domain correlation is NOT established - see caveat.
caveat: The separability AUC uses all 1,659 locked test_matched objects and is reliable. The novelty correlation uses only the 400 objects that reached the persisted review queue - a top-400 truncation that is selection-biased by construction, so r=+0.579 must NOT be read as evidence that the ranking is domain-driven. Recomputing it needs novelty scores for all 1,659 objects, which requires re-running 03_evaluate.py. Treat the correlation as unmeasured until then.
